# RS Tools

> High-performance, open-source suite of 50+ private browser-based utilities for images, PDFs, resumes, and code formatting. Zero server uploads.

RS Tools executes all data processing locally inside client browser memory using HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly, and the Web Cryptography API.

## Core Image Utilities

- [Image Compressor](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/image-compressor): Client-side PNG, JPG, and WebP compression reducing filesize up to 85% with bicubic downsampling.
- [Image Format Converter](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/image-converter): Convert images between WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, and BMP with canvas rendering.
- [Background Remover](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/background-remover): Chroma-key background eraser with Redmean perceptual color distance and Gaussian edge feathering.
- [Image Resizer](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/image-resizer): Scale dimensions by pixels or aspect ratio presets (16:9, 1:1, 4:3).
- [Crop Tool](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/crop-tool): Interactive freehand and aspect ratio bounding box image cropper.
- [Watermark Generator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/watermark-generator): Overlay customizable copyright stamps and brand watermarks.
- [SVG to Raster](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/svg-to-raster): Rasterize scalable vector graphics to high-resolution PNG, JPG, or WebP.
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/palette-extractor): Extract dominant hex swatches directly from raster image canvases.
- [EXIF Metadata Scrubber](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/metadata-remover): Strip GPS coordinates, camera serials, and timestamps from photo metadata.
- [QR Code Generator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/qr-generator): Generate high-resolution vector and raster QR codes for URLs, WiFi, and text.
- [Favicon Package Generator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/favicon-generator): Export multi-resolution favicon asset bundles (16x16, 32x32, 180x180, 512x512).

## PDF Document Utilities

- [Merge PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file via client-side stream merging.
- [Split PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/split-pdf): Extract individual pages or custom sheet ranges into separate PDF documents.
- [Compress PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/compress-pdf): Optimize PDF filesize by compressing cross-reference tables and stripping unused fonts.
- [PDF to Images](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/pdf-to-images): Rasterize vector PDF pages into 150, 300, and 450 DPI PNG and JPG images.
- [Images to PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/images-to-pdf): Convert collections of image files into a compiled PDF document.
- [Protect PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/protect-pdf): Encrypt PDF documents with strong client-side passwords.
- [Unlock PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/unlock-pdf): Remove user and owner restrictions from password-protected PDFs.
- [Rotate PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Extract Text from PDF](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/extract-text-pdf): Asynchronously parse embedded text streams to extract clean paragraphs.

## Developer & Career Utilities

- [ATS Resume Builder](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/resume-builder): Create 100% ATS-compliant resumes with 150+ designs, keyword scoring, and instant PDF compilation.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/json-formatter): Format, validate, lint, and minify JSON payloads with syntax tree view.
- [Regex Tester & Debugger](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/regex-tester): Test regular expressions in real-time with capture groups and regex explanations.
- [JWT Token Decoder](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens offline (header, payload, expiry).
- [Cryptographic Hash Generator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/hash-generator): Calculate SHA-256, SHA-512, and MD5 hashes using Web Cryptography (SubtleCrypto).
- [Text & Code Diff Checker](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/diff-checker): Compare two text or code files with side-by-side unified diff analysis.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/base64-tool): Encode and decode text or binary data to and from Base64 strings.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/url-encoder): Encode and decode query strings and percent-encoded URLs.
- [CSS Minifier](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/css-minifier): Minify CSS stylesheets to reduce file size.
- [JavaScript Minifier](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/js-minifier): Compress JavaScript code directly in the browser.
- [UUID Generator](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/uuid-generator): Generate cryptographically secure v4 UUID identifiers.

## Documentation & Standards

- [Privacy Policy](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/): 100% client-side privacy guarantee; zero data transmission to external servers.
- [XML Sitemap](https://rsutilitytools.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all 52 website URLs.
